cdr_report_app - vendored from CDR-Analysis/Report_App (code, configs/default.yaml,
assets/fonts). Sherlocks uses it for the Demo data source and the Urdu/English PDF
engine; live EMS search does not need it. The layout (src/, configs/, assets/) is the
one Report_App's own code expects. No .env or credentials are copied - none are needed.
To refresh: re-copy those three from Report_App.
